notes.title: Demo bug fixes and balancing #1
notes.notes: [h1]Bugs fixed with this update[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Fix private lobbies not being private[/p][/*][*][p]Overall collisions have been improved[/p][/*][*][p]Fix broken item spawns (unreachable or wrong spawns)[/p][/*][*][p]Voice chat delay should be lower[/p][/*][*][p]Fix loudness bar bad visualization / not accurate[/p][/*][*][p]Fix crouch bug for clients[/p][/*][*][p]Fix some stats not syncing correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fix UI issues after loading[/p][/*][*][p]Added the implementation so you can escape out of the settings window in the lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Fix issue with playercount being wrong, making you unable to escape (let us know if it still happens, we have tested and it never happened for us)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix inventory bug with dropped item[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Balancing[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Increased kick range. Makes jackboxes a bit easier to kick[/p][/*][*][p]Jackbox speed has been lowered[/p][/*][*][p]Jester is less sensitive to voice (so you don't have to be scared to talk)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased player speed when down[/p][/*][*][p]Turned off collision of player with jackboxes so they can't trap you while downed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]More bugs may be found and balancing is still an ongoing process for which we want your input! We hope you enjoy this patch that fixes some issues.[/p][p][/p][p]A positive review on the demo would help us out tremendously btw![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/feVPh8Yeed" style="button" buttoncolor="#7376ce"]Discord Server[/url][/p]
